Court has passed the following order:-
"1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today, is taken on record.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that on the basis of compromise,
Principal Judge, Family Court, Kasganj has quashed the proceeding of Maintenance Case No. 232 of 2023, under Section 125 Cr.P.C. vide order dated 11.02.2023.
He next submitted that in light of order dated 11.02.2023 passed by Principal Judge, Family Court, Kasganj, present proceeding may also be quashed.
4. Learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Kasganj is directed to submit report as to whether any such order dated 11.02.2023 has been passed or not.

5. List this case on 18.9.2023.
6. Registrar(Compliance) is directed to send a copy of this order to Principal Judge,
Family Court, Kasganj within 24 hours for strict compliance.
5.

Interim order, if any, shall remain continue till the next date of listing."
4. Pursuant to the order of this Court dated 29.8.2023, order of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Kasganj dated 11.02.2023 along with letter dated 15.09.2023 has been submitted before the Court.
From the perusal of order dated 11.02.2023, it is apparently clear that proceeding initiated under Section 125 Cr.P.C. has been quashed on the basis of compromise between the parties.
5. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that in light of aforesaid fact, present proceeding may be quashed.
6. Learned AGA has not objected the aforesaid fact and submitted that in case proceedings is quashed, he would have no objection.
7. In view of above, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
The matter has been mutually settled between the parties, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.

8. Thus in view of the well settled principle of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the matters of Krishnappa & Ors. vs. State of Karnataka; 2021 0 Supreme(SC) 529, Parbatbhai Aahir @
Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and Ors. vs. State of Gujarat and another; 2017 9 SCC 641, B.S.
Joshi Vs. State of Haryana; 2003(4) SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Burea of Investigation and another; (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 677, Gian Singh Vs. Stated of Punjab; (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & others Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2014) Supreme Today 642, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
